subject.title: /learn's skill-authoring-and-apply pipeline has no owner gate, unlike the equivalent plugin-install path

question: Should Skill Workshop creation/application and its approval resolution require owner or `operator.admin`, and should the implicit same-chat plugin approval fallback be narrowed globally or only for `skill_workshop`?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the permanent boundary affects non-owner chat users, plugin approval semantics, and potentially shipped direct Skill Workshop behavior.

options.title: Gate Skill Workshop writes
options.body: Require owner or `operator.admin` for `/learn`, `skill_workshop` lifecycle writes, and approval of those writes, then audit the shared implicit approval fallback separately.

options.title: Gate only apply
options.body: Allow non-owner users to draft proposals but require owner or `operator.admin` for apply/reject/quarantine and approval resolution.

options.title: Document shared-agent trust
options.body: Keep same-chat behavior and document that command-authorized non-owner users can participate in Skill Workshop writes on a shared agent.

recommendation.title: Gate Skill Workshop writes
recommendation.body: Require owner or `operator.admin` for `/learn`, `skill_workshop` lifecycle writes, and approval of those writes, then audit the shared implicit approval fallback separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature-history evidence points to this owner boundary and Skill Workshop implementation work.
